pretraining_model_card: Self-supervised audio pretraining on 10k hours WenetSpeech L; no tokenizer
architecture: Wav2Vec2 base; 12 layers; hidden size 768; about 95 million parameters
adaptation: New project phone CTC head; 45 phones plus blank; convolutional frontend frozen; head first then final two transformer layers
warning: Chinese audio pretraining is not verified Shanghai dialect alignment. CTC emissions are not complete phone/syllable boundaries. Training/test boundary validation remains outstanding.
